# Trainlog

> Personal sports reflection journal powered by voice notes.

Trainlog is a voice-first sports reflection journal designed to help users better understand their training experiences through natural speech.

## Links

- [Live App](https://trainlog-journal.vercel.app/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://trainlog-journal.vercel.app/privacy)
- [Terms of Use](https://trainlog-journal.vercel.app/terms)
- [Source Code](https://github.com/druedaro/trainlog)

## Features

- Voice-first training journal with AI-powered transcription
- Structured analysis of training sessions (themes, energy, mood)
- Calendar-based history and weekly insights
- Personalized learning content (Discover)
- AI Coach (Anna) with full journal context
- Export and delete all personal data

## Tech Stack

React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Firebase, Groq Whisper, Google Gemini, Vercel.
